v0.3.0.description:
First beta of FTL Archipelago, on Windows and Linux. [Français plus bas](#français).

## English

### What to download

| You play on | Download from this page | And also |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` and `Hyperspace.dll` | [ftlman](https://github.com/afishhh/ftlman/releases/latest) (Windows zip). It downloads Hyperspace by itself. |
| **Linux** | `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` and `Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so` | [ftlman](https://github.com/afishhh/ftlman/releases) (Linux build) and `Hyperspace.ftl`, inside `FTL.Hyperspace.1.23.1-Linux.zip` from [Hyperspace 1.23.1](https://github.com/FTL-Hyperspace/FTL-Hyperspace/releases/tag/v1.23.1) |
| **Generating the seed** | `ftl.apworld`, and `presets.zip` for ready-made YAML files | [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) 0.6.7 or newer |

### Install on Windows

> [!WARNING]
> Close FTL first. In ftlman pick **Hyperspace 1.23.1**, not a newer one. After **every** Apply, copy the
> Archipelago `Hyperspace.dll` again: Apply puts the official one back.

1. In Steam, turn off **Steam Cloud** for FTL. Copy `Documents\My Games\FasterThanLight` somewhere safe.
2. Unzip ftlman, put `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` in the `mods` folder next to `ftlman.exe`, start ftlman and click
   **Scan**.
3. In the **Hyperspace** menu pick **1.23.1**, click the mod so it turns blue, click **Apply**. Accept if it
   offers to switch FTL to 1.6.9.
4. Copy the `Hyperspace.dll` from this page into the FTL folder (Steam: right click FTL, Manage, Browse local
   files) and replace the file.
5. Start FTL from Steam: the Archipelago logo and a connection panel appear on the main menu.

Step by step with screenshots: [Setup on Windows](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.md).

### Install on Linux

For the native Steam version (1.6.13), not Proton. Turn off Steam Cloud and copy
`~/.local/share/FasterThanLight` first. Then, in the folder where you downloaded the files:

```sh
D=~/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/"FTL Faster Than Light"/data
ftlman hyperspace-install 1.23.1 -d "$D"
ftlman patch -d "$D" ./Hyperspace.ftl ./ArchipelagoFTL.ftl
cp "$D/Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so" "$D/Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so.official"
cp Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so "$D/"
```

Start FTL from Steam. Full guide: [Setup on Linux](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.md).

### Play

Type the server address, the port and your slot name in the panel at the bottom left of the main menu, and
connect. Then start a **new** game. `TAB` opens the dashboard during a run. No server? Click **Solo mode**.

If you apply mods again in ftlman later, copy the Archipelago library again afterwards.

### What changed since 0.1.0

- Windows support.
- New TAB dashboard with 5 pages, and new notifications.
- A start-of-run menu to bring a weapon, a drone and a crew member you have collected.
- Solo mode is saved, and its shop sells your own items.
- A run only counts if it was started with the seed loaded. Continue cannot bring back a run from another seed.
- The goal is written in plain words in the menu and in TAB.
- A wrong slot name now says so in the connection panel.
- Options that did nothing were removed.

Seeds made with 0.1.0 must be generated again. Mac is not supported. Problems: open an
[issue](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/issues) with your `FTL_HS.log` (in the FTL folder, or its
`data` folder on Linux).

## Français

### Quoi télécharger

| Tu joues sur | À prendre sur cette page | Et aussi |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` et `Hyperspace.dll` | [ftlman](https://github.com/afishhh/ftlman/releases/latest) (zip Windows). Il télécharge Hyperspace tout seul. |
| **Linux** | `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` et `Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so` | [ftlman](https://github.com/afishhh/ftlman/releases) (version Linux) et `Hyperspace.ftl`, dans `FTL.Hyperspace.1.23.1-Linux.zip` de [Hyperspace 1.23.1](https://github.com/FTL-Hyperspace/FTL-Hyperspace/releases/tag/v1.23.1) |
| **Pour générer la seed** | `ftl.apworld`, et `presets.zip` pour des YAML tout prêts | [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) 0.6.7 ou plus récent |

### Installer sous Windows

> [!WARNING]
> Ferme FTL avant de commencer. Dans ftlman, choisis **Hyperspace 1.23.1**, pas une version plus récente. Après
> **chaque** Apply, recopie le `Hyperspace.dll` Archipelago : Apply remet l'officiel.

1. Dans Steam, désactive **Steam Cloud** pour FTL. Copie `Documents\My Games\FasterThanLight` dans un endroit sûr.
2. Décompresse ftlman, mets `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` dans le dossier `mods` à côté de `ftlman.exe`, lance ftlman et
   clique sur **Scan**.
3. Dans le menu **Hyperspace**, choisis **1.23.1**, clique sur le mod pour qu'il devienne bleu, puis sur
   **Apply**. Accepte s'il propose de passer FTL en 1.6.9.
4. Copie le `Hyperspace.dll` de cette page dans le dossier de FTL (Steam : clic droit sur FTL, Gérer, Parcourir
   les fichiers locaux) et remplace le fichier.
5. Lance FTL depuis Steam : le logo Archipelago et un panneau de connexion apparaissent sur le menu.

Pas à pas avec des captures : [Installation sous Windows](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.fr.md).

### Installer sous Linux

Pour la version Steam native (1.6.13), pas Proton. Désactive Steam Cloud et copie
`~/.local/share/FasterThanLight` avant tout. Ensuite, dans le dossier où tu as téléchargé les fichiers :

```sh
D=~/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/"FTL Faster Than Light"/data
ftlman hyperspace-install 1.23.1 -d "$D"
ftlman patch -d "$D" ./Hyperspace.ftl ./ArchipelagoFTL.ftl
cp "$D/Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so" "$D/Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so.official"
cp Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so "$D/"
```

Lance FTL depuis Steam. Guide complet : [Installation sous Linux](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.fr.md).

### Jouer

Entre l'adresse du serveur, le port et ton nom de slot dans le panneau en bas à gauche du menu, puis connecte-toi.
Lance ensuite une **nouvelle** partie. `TAB` ouvre le tableau de bord pendant une run. Pas de serveur ? Clique
sur **Mode solo**.

Si tu réappliques les mods dans ftlman plus tard, recopie ensuite la bibliothèque Archipelago.

### Nouveautés depuis la 0.1.0

- Windows est pris en charge.
- Nouveau tableau de bord sur `TAB` (5 pages) et nouvelles notifications.
- Un menu en début de run pour emmener une arme, un drone et un membre d'équipage déjà reçus.
- Le mode solo est sauvegardé, et sa boutique vend tes propres items.
- Une run ne compte que si elle a démarré avec la seed chargée. « Continuer » ne peut plus ramener une run
  d'une autre seed.
- L'objectif est expliqué clairement dans le menu et dans TAB.
- Un mauvais nom de slot est maintenant signalé dans le panneau de connexion.
- Les options qui ne faisaient rien ont été retirées.

Les seeds faites avec la 0.1.0 doivent être régénérées. Mac n'est pas pris en charge. Un problème ? Ouvre une
[issue](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/issues) avec ton `FTL_HS.log` (dans le dossier de FTL, ou
son dossier `data` sous Linux).

v0.3.1.description:
Bug fix release. Only the mod changed: if you have 0.3.0, update `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` in ftlman and apply again, then copy the Hyperspace library again (it is the same file as in 0.3.0).

## How to install

| | |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | [English](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.md) · [Français](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.fr.md) · [Deutsch](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.de.md) · [Español](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.es.md) · [Italiano](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.it.md) · [Português](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.pt.md) |
| **Linux** | [English](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.md) · [Français](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.fr.md) · [Deutsch](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.de.md) · [Español](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.es.md) · [Italiano](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.it.md) · [Português](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.pt.md) |

## Files

| File | Who needs it |
|---|---|
| `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` | every player |
| `Hyperspace.dll` | players on Windows |
| `Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so` | players on Linux |
| `ftl.apworld` | whoever generates the seed |
| `presets.zip` | ready-made player YAML files |

## What changed since 0.3.0

Items
- Disconnect then Connect no longer gives every item a second time (start bonuses, Archives, system levels).
- With your weapon slots and cargo full, new weapons and drones wait for room instead of being lost.
- At most 4 weapons or drones arrive per beacon, the rest at the next jumps (more could crash the game on the way back to the menu).
- A weapon still waiting when you close the game comes aboard in your next run.
- An augment received with three slots taken waits for a free slot.
- Scrap and fuel are no longer given twice after a refused seed, a fight, or solo mode.

Death Link
- A crew member you dismiss, or one who leaves with an event, no longer sends a death.
- A lost drone no longer sends a death.
- Several deaths at once send only one.

Connection panel
- Space, period and colon work on French keyboards, and the numpad works.
- A wrong slot name, a refused seed or a changed room each say so, without a wrong "server is not answering" after it.

Options (updated after release, in ftl.apworld and presets.zip)
- The default options are now the recommended ones: 5 victories with different ships on Normal or Hard, and 10 of 12 Archives. Just change your name.
- The Options Creator shows fewer, clearer groups. Fine settings are in Advanced, and a few expert ones are only in the YAML.
- The options page of the website offers the presets.

Also
- The start-of-run menu comes back after Continue if you quit before choosing.
- A pact in the Archipelago shop no longer throws its trap at other players when Trap Link is off.
- Texts that were too long are shortened or use a smaller font instead of spilling out.
- The Windows setup page is now step by step with pictures.

## What changed since 0.3.2

Shop and balance
- The Archipelago shop is split by sector: the packages of sector 5 need you to reach sector 5.
- Weapons, drones and augments come in bundles (3, 2 and 3 by default): fewer items, a smaller shop. A bundle shows as an important package.
- When a seed has far more items than checks, head starts and crew go first instead of growing the shop.
- Presets by game length: short (about 5 h), medium (about 10 h, the defaults) and long (20 h or more).

Ships
- Only some ship layouts are in a seed (7 by default), so a 5 victory goal does not leave a lot of ships nobody plays. The hangar marks the others NOT IN SEED.
- Beating the Flagship with a layout also sends its remaining sector checks.

New options (off by default)
- Full System Upgrades: one Progressive item gives every level of its system.
- Per-ship shop, per-ship systemsanity and per-ship upgrades.
- Death Link can count clone bay deaths.
- Systemsanity is now off by default (half the systems are already aboard at the start).

Fixes
- With the clone bay, a crew member who comes back no longer sends a Death Link, and renaming a crew member no longer sends one.
- A weapon that arrived just before a crash comes back, never twice.
- Weapons and drones that don't fit in the cargo hold wait for room instead of being lost.

v0.4.1-mv.1.description:
**Test version for FTL: Multiverse.** It works well in my tests, but expect bugs: this is the point, I need your reports. Not for the base game: for that, take the [latest release](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/releases/latest).

What is in it: the 55 MV ships and 147 layouts (unlocked by Archipelago items in the MV hangar), MV weapons, drones and augments in the item pool (in bundles), Archipelago beacons in the MV sectors, MV endings counting as victories, and 26 MV achievements as optional checks.

## Install

1. Install FTL Archipelago as usual first ([Windows](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Windows.md), [Linux](https://github.com/TheLiloji/FTLArchipelago/blob/main/docs/wiki/Setup-Linux.md)), but with the `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` and `ftl.apworld` from **this** page.
2. Get Multiverse 5.5.1 (Data and Assets). If you use the MV installer, it also installs the newest Hyperspace: that is fine, step 3 puts the right one back.
3. In ftlman: pick **Hyperspace 1.23.1**, put MV Data, then MV Assets, then **ArchipelagoFTL last** in the mod list, and click Apply.
4. Copy `Hyperspace.dll` (Windows) or `Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so` (Linux) from this page into the FTL folder again, after Apply.
5. In your YAML, add `multiverse: true` (and `multiverse_achievements: true` if you want the MV achievements as checks).

You start with the MV Kestrel. The hangar only lets you fly the ships you received.

## Reporting

Something odd, a crash, a check that did not send, a price that feels wrong? Send me your `FTL_HS.log` (in the FTL folder, or its `data` folder on Linux) right after it happens, and say what you were doing. Every report helps a lot.
v0.4.1-mv.1.title: Multiverse test version 1 (based on 0.4.1)

v0.4.2.description:
Bug fixes for 0.4.x. Seeds made with 0.4.0 or 0.4.1 still work. **The Hyperspace library changes this time**: update `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` in ftlman, apply, then copy the new library (`Hyperspace.dll` on Windows, `Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so` on Linux).

- **Only Archipelago unlocks ships now.** FTL could unlock ships by itself (an event, an achievement, a win). These unlocks are now refused, and at the main menu any ship FTL unlocked before is locked again. A run with a ship you did not receive counts for nothing, and the hangar marks it NOT RECEIVED.
- **Achievement checks are sent.** They never were before: the mod was reading the wrong list.
- A Type B or C layout now needs its ship's key too, like the logic says.
- A check now shows the item it sends and who gets it.
- New: a Linux library for FTL from GOG or Humble (`Hyperspace.1.6.12.amd64.so`).
- The lock icon on augments you can't sell is FTL's again, not our logo.

v0.4.4-mv.1.title: Multiverse test version 4 (based on 0.4.4)

v0.5.0.description:
New options from your votes, a dashboard rebuilt from scratch, a run start menu with pictures, paste in the connect screen, a new event, blood pacts, and a lot of fixes from your reports. Seeds made with 0.4 still work with the 0.5 mod.

## Updating from 0.4

1. In ftlman, replace `ArchipelagoFTL.ftl` with the one from this page and click Apply.
2. **Copy the Hyperspace library from this page into the FTL folder again**, after Apply: `Hyperspace.dll` (Windows), `Hyperspace.1.6.13.amd64.so` (Linux, Steam) or `Hyperspace.1.6.12.amd64.so` (Linux, GOG/Humble). Apply always puts the official one back, and 0.5 needs this new one: without it, paste, deals with full augment slots and packages with a full cargo do not work.
3. Replace `ftl.apworld` too: the new options need a seed made with 0.5, and a 0.4 host refuses a 0.5 YAML instead of silently dropping its options.

## New options

- **Free Upgrades**: system levels you receive are installed for free, right away and at the start of every run.
- **System Install**: systems whose blueprint you received come aboard for free, at the start of every run or as soon as they arrive.
- **Run Start Scrap**: every new run starts with a share of all the scrap items you received.
- **Combat Checks per Ship**: the first fights each ship wins in a run send checks. Those fights give part of their scrap.
- **Victory Collects the Layout**: a victory also sends the layout's sector checks left, or with `everything` its achievements, system and fight checks too.
- **Sector Logic `power`**: before far sectors and the flagship, the logic expects shield layers, weapons and engines on the ship doing the check.
- **Excluded Ships and Layouts**: leave out the ships or layouts you never want to fly.
- A `first_game` preset, clearer YAML errors and warnings, and the options page rewritten in six languages.

## Dashboard (TAB)

- **Checks** as a grid: one row per ship, one box per sector, fight or level. The ship you fly comes first, then what counts on any ship, then the other ships. A banner says how many checks are left on this ship, and in this sector for the shop. Point at a box to see what it is, and for a done check what it gave and to whom.
- **Achievements** with their real game icons, **Victories** with each layout's ship picture, **First crew** as cards with each race's sprite.
- **Ships** with a picture of every layout you unlocked.
- **Overview**: click a category to open its checks.
- **Systems** with FTL's system icons, green once usable, grey while locked.
- **Journal** colored by item class (progression, useful, trap, filler), with what each bundle contained.
- A **This run** card with your fights, the next fight check and next run's scrap.
- Names follow the game's language (achievements, races, systems), and FTL's own tooltip no longer draws over the dashboard.

## In game

- **Run start menu with pictures**: the weapon, the drone or the crew member's sprite next to each choice. Long names go on two lines instead of being cut.
- **Paste in the connect screen**: Ctrl+V pastes in any field. Copy the room's whole `/connect host:port` line (even with text after it) or `host:port`, and both address and port fill in. The field the server blames turns red, and the button says it is connecting.
- After "The seed changed" and FTL's restart, the password you typed is filled in again, once.
- New Archipelago event: pirates hold a package, often a friend's. Pay them, or win the fight and it goes out for free.
- **Blood pacts** on the Archipelago shop's second page: more scrap, but 5, 10 or 20% of the time one of your crew dies for good. Never your last one.
- The shop beacon says **AP STORE** on the map, the event beacons keep **ARCHIPELAGO**.
- An empty shop slot says why: waiting for the server, sold in sector N, sold aboard another ship, or next run.
- Messages last in real seconds (they flashed by on fast screens or with the frame limit off), long ones stay longer, and "this run does not count" stays on screen.
- Unlock messages use the game's name for the item, in your language.

## Fixes

- Deals and blood pacts can be bought even with all 3 augment slots full.
- Archipelago packages can be bought even with four weapons and a full cargo.
- Quests can no longer replace an Archipelago shop or event beacon.
- A refused Clone Bay or Medbay purchase gives back the system it replaced, at its level.
- A refused Drone Control no longer leaves its free drone in your cargo.
- An event selling an upgrade for a system at its Archipelago cap no longer takes your scrap.
- A system needs its blueprint to be bought, installed or shown as unlocked.
- Another World without Trap Link has a choice to just move on.
- The NOT IN SEED labels no longer draw over the ship list help.
- Connecting to a local server no longer shows "not answering" first.

Thanks to Trapper444 for the Spanish review and the logo, and to everyone who reported bugs and voted.
